case.name: Whats Her Face
case.description: Whats Her Face makes a cameo appearance!

case.name: KISADETH'D!!
case.description: The Arrow'd Guy Fairy kills Cheerleader after briefly turning her into a Kisakae model.

case.name: Squished ant
case.description: The ant formerly known as Cheerleader gets squished under a giant foot.

case.name: So and So's fate
case.description: Cheerleader describes the horrible fate that befell her friend So and So.

case.name: The Ugly One's fate
case.description: Cheerleader describes the horrible fate that befell her friend The Ugly One.

case.name: Whats Her Face's... fate??
case.description: Cheerleader says she didn't invite her "friend" Whats Her Face. Huh, maybe Whats Her Face was actually the lucky one...

case.name: Whats Her Face the Loser
case.description: Cheerleader refers to her "friend" Whats Her Face as a loser. With friends like these...

case.name: Spontaneous combustion
case.description: Cheerleader has suddenly caught fire. Voices from above suggest that it was a giant with a magnifying glass.

case.name: KISAKAE'D!!
case.description: Cheerleader has been transformed into a Kisakae model.

case.name: Missile-fire
case.description: Cheerleader got hit by a stray rocket accidentally fired by Brock.

case.name: We must protect the queen! I have six legs!
case.description: Cheerleader somehow transformed herself into an ant.

case.name: Weighty matters
case.description: Cheerleader has been crushed under a giant weight (a "heavy lourde"). Homsar pops up to drop some "wisdom".

case.name: Cheeleader go down da hoooooooole...
case.description: The bottomless pit that took Cheerleader's shoes is back for Cheerleader herself.

case.name: Cheerwhonow?
case.description: Cheerleader got accidentally glitched out of existence. The game doesn't even register her name any longer. (The intention is not that Monika did this on purpose.)
